_comment: The scrapyard's top-level data of games/scrap-yard/game.json that is not rules (owner: the wiring step, label wiring). The game's build script copies every block here that does not start with an underscore over the same top-level key of game.json, through scripts/content/yard_top.py (apply), after resolving every {id} in a text to the names register's byId (scripts/content/yard/names.json): invented names are never written as literals (yard-design.md D13). Never edit game.json's copy: change this file and re-run the build (then npm run sync). The store listing is beside it in scripts/content/yard-store.json.

_why.app.displayName: the register's title, so the loading animation's plates spell it (one plate a word) and the home screen shows it; 14 characters (an iPhone home screen shows about 12 in full: the owner sees 'Scrap to Ingot' or its shortened form on the phone test; Proudly Adequate's 16 was accepted)
_why.app.slug, iosBundleId, androidPackage: from the title, as the four games' are; com.example.* stays the house's placeholder until the owner's own domain replaces all five (spam.md 4, validate --release refuses it)
_why.app.trackingText: the iOS tracking prompt in the game's voice (weighbridge-plain), promising nothing: the first yard shows no ad
_why.soundPack: null: no shared pack; the game's own sounds are games/scrap-yard/assets/sfx (yard-design.md 11, the fingerprint's dimension 16)
_why.theme.colors.background: the late-day sky of the style sheet (yard-style.md 2, sky #A9C8D8): the splash's colour, the colour the loading animation fades in from, and the Android adaptive icon's background (fully covered by its opaque yellow layer)
_why.theme, other colours: the style sheet's palette (paper, ink, hi-vis, rust); the salvage screens draw from src/ui/salvage/palette.ts and read only theme.colors.background; the rest serve the shared shell's fallbacks
_why.strings.currencyName, currencySymbol: the register's currency and its symbol (yard-stage1.md 5.1: the symbol is §)
_why.strings.prestige*: the game has no run reset (prestige none, yard-design.md 1.2); the shared schema requires the fields

app.trackingText: This lets ads you choose to watch be more relevant to you. The yard works the same whatever you answer.

strings.prestigeDescription: This game has no run reset: the yard you build stays.
